the candidate teachers’ attitudes are not in line with the expectations.
the candidate teachers have a positive environmental attitude but this attitude is not sufficient to be regarded as an environmentalist.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the candidate teachers are not aware of environmental problems and they have a positive environmental attitude.

the nature and human-based attitudes of the candidate primary school teachers are at an acceptable level, but the fact that their human based attitude is not as high as their nature based attitude makes the necessity of environmental education courses for the candidate teachers more evident.
environmental education is an important part of the teacher training program, and it is essential that the environmental education course is applied and theoretically effective.
The main takeaway from our work is that
environmental education should be included in the curriculum of the Faculty of Education and should be taught by environmental education experts.
the environmental attitude levels of the candidates are not satisfactory.
environmental education should be provided in a way that the nature based attitudes of candidate teachers are strengthened and their human based attitudes are weakened.
